[Conversation timestamp: 2026-08-29]
I work as a Security Consultant at Northwind Labs. On August 27 I moved the Beacon project demo deadline from September 2 to September 5, 2026. Correction: the final deadline is September 6, not September 5. The memory-service retain calls on my benchmark host have recently taken around 14 seconds per extraction call, based on 12 recorded calls. I am considering the Lite model for retain, but I have not chosen a replacement yet. My colleague Maya thinks the Small model would be best; that is her opinion, not mine. Never put my API keys or tokens into chat messages. Yesterday I restarted the memory service after changing the reranker to the Pro reranker, and the service came back with no data loss. The slowdown might be caused by high reasoning effort, but we have not proven the cause. I initially said the live database directory was /srv/appdata/live-db; correction: the live directory is /srv/appdata/live-db-new, and the old path is rollback-only.
